evidence.source_name: Pérez Art Museum Miami — official source
supports: PAMM's building was designed by Swiss architectural firm Herzog & de Meuron.
PAMM houses a collection of 20th and 21st century art with an emphasis on Latin America, the Caribbean and the African diaspora.
PAMM has two floors of galleries with 15 gallery spaces.
PAMM is at 1103 Biscayne Blvd., Miami, FL 33132.
PAMM is in Downtown Miami between the Frost Science Museum and Biscayne Bay, with hanging gardens and large scale sculptures overlooking Biscayne Bay.
PAMM is open Thursday from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. and Friday through Monday from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., and is closed Tuesday and Wednesday.
